# World-class science. Life-changing impact.

Get an inside look at the work we do every day to define what's possible and transform patients'
lives through science.

[ see what drives us ][68]

## Life + Science

[ view more stories ][69]

## Areas of focus
* [
  
  ### Oncology
  
  Building on our heritage in the treatment of solid tumors, we’re solving complex scientific
  problems for cancer patients everywhere.
  
  Learn more about Oncology ][70]
* [
  
  ### Hematology
  
  Known for delivering many transformational firsts in hematology, we’re committed to breaking new
  ground across diseases with high unmet need.
  
  Learn more about Hematology ][71]
* [
  
  ### Neuroscience
  
  We’re dedicated to championing the needs and experiences of people living with neurological and
  psychiatric diseases through disease-modifying and symptomatic therapies.
  
  Learn more about neuroscience ][72]
* [
  
  ### Immunology
  
  We’re working to deliver meaningful solutions that address unmet needs in dermatology,
  gastroenterology, pulmonology and rheumatology.
  
  Learn more about immunology ][73]
* [
  
  ### Cardiovascular
  
  Building on a 70-year legacy of paradigm-changing medicines, we’re leveraging our experience and
  expertise to take cardiovascular research to the next level.
  
  Learn more about cardiovascular ][74]

[ View more ][75]

## Pipeline

AS OF APRIL 30, 2026
* 50 Compounds in development
* 40+ Disease areas being studied

Our pipeline targets areas where we can deliver transformative medicines — for patients who need
them most.

[ EXPLORE THE PIPELINE ][76]

drug distribution and supplies in Nigeria. it maintains an active relationship with professionals
within and outside Nigeria. The company is presently active in the importation of pharmaceutical
products that are duly registered with NAFDAC.

[View More][16]

* [Who We Are][17]
* [Quality][18]

We are a leading pharmaceutical company in Lagos largest city of Nigeria that specialises in the
importation, sales, marketing and distribution of pharmaceutical products in the Nigerian market.

The quality of our products is something that we never leave to chance. The products are checked at
every level to ensure complete flawlessness and customer satisfaction. The quality inspections are
conducted in the laboratories according to rules evolved by us. Our dedication to quality in
everything we do is uncompromising, and covers every stage of the development, importation product
and marketing of our medicines from the supply of materials through manufacturing and approval by
the strictest authorities in Nigeria.

# World-class science. Life-changing impact.

Get an inside look at the work we do every day to define what's possible and transform patients'
lives through science.

[ see what drives us ][68]

## Life + Science

[ view more stories ][69]

## Areas of focus
* [
  
  ### Oncology
  
  Building on our heritage in the treatment of solid tumors, we’re solving complex scientific
  problems for cancer patients everywhere.
  
  Learn more about Oncology ][70]
* [
  
  ### Hematology
  
  Known for delivering many transformational firsts in hematology, we’re committed to breaking new
  ground across diseases with high unmet need.
  
  Learn more about Hematology ][71]
* [
  
  ### Neuroscience
  
  We’re dedicated to championing the needs and experiences of people living with neurological and
  psychiatric diseases through disease-modifying and symptomatic therapies.
  
  Learn more about neuroscience ][72]
* [
  
  ### Immunology
  
  We’re working to deliver meaningful solutions that address unmet needs in dermatology,
  gastroenterology, pulmonology and rheumatology.
  
  Learn more about immunology ][73]
* [
  
  ### Cardiovascular
  
  Building on a 70-year legacy of paradigm-changing medicines, we’re leveraging our experience and
  expertise to take cardiovascular research to the next level.
  
  Learn more about cardiovascular ][74]

[ View more ][75]

## Pipeline

AS OF APRIL 30, 2026
* 50 Compounds in development
* 40+ Disease areas being studied

Our pipeline targets areas where we can deliver transformative medicines — for patients who need
them most.

### Vision & Mission
### 
### Mission et Vision

Our vision is to secure access to quality drugs. Our mission, with a pharmaceutical market that
represents more than $20 billion, bringing people quality products at affordable prices remains a
key challenge in Africa. CFAO Healthcare continues to improve healthcare on the continent by
producing and distributing pharmaceutical and medical products along with related services.

[ View more ][134]

### Carbon neutrality

Like the CFAO group as a whole, CFAO Healthcare is committed to contributing to decarbonization
efforts by aligning itself with the trajectory of the Paris agreements: reducing our greenhouse gas
emissions by 50% by 2030 compared with 2019 and achieving carbon neutrality by 2050.

[ View more ][135]

# Our History

1975 Opening of the first wholesale distributor company in the FOT
* Starting up of the activities of pre-wholesale In Algeria
* Starting up of the activities of Agent / distributor in Angola
Activity of Pre-Wholesale, Creation of E.P.DIS in Rouen (France)
Starting up of the activities of diagnostic & medical services Euracare (Nigeria and Ghana)
2 acquisitions
* Medimport (Mozambique)
* Opella South Africa which becomes CFAO Healthcare South Africa
3 acquisitions
* Missionpharma (Denmark / India)
* Assene-Laborex (Nigeria)
* Stockpharma (Portugal)
Acquisition of Maphar (Morocco) Sanofi contract with E.P.DIS France
Opening of the first wholesale distributor company in Dakar (Senegal), then development of the
wholesalers network in French-speaking sub-Saharan Africa until 1990
Acquisition of Fazzini (Italia)
Acquisition of 100% of Goodlife (Kenya / Uganda)
Ouverture du premier grossiste-répartiteur dans les CTOM
* Démarrage des activités de Pre-wholesale en Algérie.
* Démarrage des activités d'Agent/distributeur en Angola
Activité de Pre-wholesale, création d'E.P.DIS à Rouen (France)
Démarrage des activités des services diagnostiques & médicaux Euracare (Nigeria et Ghana)
2 acquisitions
* Medimport (Mozambique)

## Frequently Asked Question

### 1. What does Farbe Firma specialize in manufacturing?

We are a specialized pharmaceutical formulation manufacturer focusing on Critical Care Injectables.
Our capabilities include liquid ampoules, sterile vials, Lyophilized (Freeze-Dried) injections, and
lipid emulsions across therapeutic areas like Anaesthesia, Pain Management, and Anti-infectives.


### 2. Are your manufacturing facilities WHO-GMP certified?

Yes, our manufacturing facility in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, is WHO-GMP certified. We adhere strictly to
global pharmacopeial standards (USP/BP/IP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) to ensure the
highest sterility and quality for international markets.


### 3. Do you offer Contract Manufacturing (CMO) and CDMO services?

Yes, we provide comprehensive Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.
We support global pharmaceutical companies with formulation development, private label
manufacturing, and scale-up of sterile injectables under their own brand names.


### 4. Which countries do you currently export to?

Farbe Firma exports to over 30 countries across Latin America, Africa, CIS, Southeast Asia, and the
Middle East. We have a dedicated export department that manages logistics and supply chain
compliance for global partners.


### 5. Do you provide Regulatory Dossiers and registration support?

Absolutely. We support our partners with complete regulatory documentation, including Dossiers
(CTD/ACTD formats), Certificates of Analysis (COA), and Stability Data to facilitate smooth product
registration in your local market.


### 6. How can I request a price quote or product sample?

For bulk inquiries, contract manufacturing proposals, or sample requests, please contact our export
team directly at [director@farbefirma.org][57] or via WhatsApp at +91 932 797 4224.

controlling the manufacture, importation, exportation, distribution, advertisement, sale and use of

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

## Our supply-integrity promise.

broker, we hold no speculative stock, and we do not buy on the grey market.

A batch Certificate of Analysis, the WHO-format CoPP, the manufacturer's GMP certificate and the
cold-chain trail travel with the consignment, prepared to your destination regulator's expectation.

### To your licensed entity

We supply the WHO-GMP product; the importer of record is your own licensed local entity. One named
desk carries the order from purchase order to the signature on the delivery note.

outside the US. That is the manufacturing base we buy against, then QA, dossier and ship on your
behalf.

a 21‑year story of reliability, scale, and care driven by

## Excellent Client Service Delivery

We provide excellent customer care, advisory services and
support tailored to the needs of Healthcare providers.
We have created a customer-centric system with our staff
equipped with the requisite tools to deliver efficiency and
best-in-class services.

## NHP Online
## Ordering Pad

## For New Heights Pharma Wholesales Ltd

With our Online Ordering Pad, registered pharmacies and
hospitals are able to place their orders and monitor their
transactions online real-time.

[ GET STARTED ][30]

## A one stop Healthcare Product
## Wholesale Centre

New Heights Pharma delivers quality healthcare products from its over 3000sqm wholesale and
distribution centre located in the centre of Lagos to over 4000 Healthcare providers in Nigeria and
across Africa.

## Nationwide Distribution Network

New Heights Pharma has one of the most extensive distribution network in Nigeria. Headquartered from
Lagos, We are able to supply quality healthcare products and services to over 4000 healthcare
providers and institutions in Nigeria, using our own logistics team trained on the importance of
Good Distribution Practice as well as other accredited logistics companies.

#### Our Services

##### Wholesale

We as wholesalers act as middlemen for retail Pharmacies, Hospitals and other Health institutions.

[ Learn More ][32]

##### Distribution

We represent and distribute/Market products for International and Local brand that we are in
partnership with using dedicated field force personnel

[ Learn More ][33]

##### Marketing

We provide information by advertising and promoting our brands and product to the public.as well as
market and detail our products and services to healthcare professionals.

##### Consulting

We leverage our in-depth and cutting edge knowledge of the regulatory and compliance landscape to
provide a range of pharmaceutical consulting.

###### Our Culture

#### Excellent Service Delivery

We provide excellent services and support tailored to the needs of our customers. We have created a
customer focused environment where our staff are equipped with the tools to deliver quality products
and best-in-class services.

Receiving front door delivery service for your order is only a matter of getting in touch with our
customer care team.

We provide nationwide delivery services for orders received by Email, Text messages & Telephone
calls:
* 24 hours door step delivery within Lagos
* 72 hours nationwide door step delivery

At New Heights Pharma we strive to provide an efficient and fast turnaround on all orders placed.
Our customer relations officers are available between:
* 8am – 5pm Mondays to Fridays
* 9am – 3pm on Saturdays and Public holidays

###### Our Product

#### Leveraging Technology in Distribution and Sales

We have over the years developed requisite technological capabilities to automate our processes and
make transactions with our customers easy and seamless. With our Online Ordering Pad, registered
retail pharmacies and hospitals/clinics are able to make transactions and monitor their transactions
online real-time. With our app, customers are able to achieve the following:
* Automatically generate purchase orders for delivery
* Monitor orders online from the point of order to delivery
* Order to Cash Management and Automation
* Store transaction history with our company
* Get online notification on every order process
* Use one account to place orders for multiple locations and more

NIROPHARM is the Umbrella Body of Nigerian Representatives of Overseas Pharmaceutical Manufacturers,
with a distinctive Research and Development Orientation that encompasses a wide variety of
pharmaceutical marketing companies, but all with a common trait of representing one or many overseas
pharmaceutical manufacturers.
NIROPHARM is at the forefront of advocating and actively supporting tangibly improvement of the
Pharma Sector in Drug Availability, Affordability, Distribution and Quality across the entire Pharma
Value Chain. The pharmaceutical market in Nigeria is estimated to reach US\$1,839 million in 2025
(Source: Statista Market Forecast, Nigerian Pharmacies, 2025)
NIROPHARM is responsible for a large percentage of Pharmaceuticals imported into, and in circulation
in Nigeria and active in the News Media over issues relevant to the industry. Imports of
Pharmaceutical products constitute 70% of the Nigerian Pharma industry, while local Manufacture
accounts for the remaining 30%.

# Mastering Global Regulatory Affairs in the Pharmaceutical Industry

## 1. Understanding the Role of Pharma Regulatory Affairs

Pharmaceutical Regulatory Affairs is a multidisciplinary function within the pharmaceutical and
biotechnology industries. It plays a critical role in ensuring that all products—drugs, biologics,
and medical devices—comply with the regulations and standards required by regulatory agencies across
various countries. The regulatory affairs department acts as the interface between pharmaceutical
companies and regulatory bodies such as the FDA (United States), EMA (European Union), CDSCO
(India), PMDA (Japan), and TGA (Australia). These agencies are responsible for reviewing and
approving drug applications, overseeing safety reporting, and enforcing post-approval compliance.

At its core, regulatory affairs involves the preparation, compilation, and submission of a wide
range of regulatory documents. These documents include dossiers (CTD/eCTD), product labels, periodic
safety reports, clinical trial applications, and responses to regulatory queries. In addition, the
regulatory team ensures that the company’s products are registered correctly in each market,
labeling is compliant, and pharmacovigilance systems are in place. Regulatory professionals must
stay up to date with evolving legislation and guidance documents, as non-compliance can result in
delayed product approvals, fines, or even market bans.

The scope of regulatory affairs is not limited to product approval. It extends to lifecycle
management, including post-marketing surveillance, renewals, and variations. Companies often rely on
regulatory intelligence to anticipate changes in global legislation and proactively adjust their
strategies. As global markets expand, pharmaceutical companies increasingly need to harmonize their
regulatory strategies across jurisdictions while addressing country-specific requirements. This need
gives rise to regulatory harmonization initiatives like ICH (International Council for
Harmonisation) and WHO’s collaborative registration procedures.

Ultimately, regulatory affairs ensure that patients have timely access to safe and effective
medications. It helps companies navigate a highly regulated environment, reduce compliance risks,
and bring innovations to market faster. As the regulatory landscape becomes more complex with the
advent of gene therapy, biosimilars, and personalized medicine, the demand for skilled regulatory
professionals continues to rise. For these reasons, pharma regulatory affairs are not just a support
function—they are a strategic pillar of the pharmaceutica [Skip to content][1]

safety reports, clinical trial applications, and responses to regulatory queries. In addition, the
regulatory team ensures that the company’s products are registered correctly in each market,
labeling is compliant, and pharmacovigilance systems are in place. Regulatory professionals must
stay up to date with evolving legislation and guidance documents, as non-compliance can result in
delayed product approvals, fines, or even market bans.

The scope of regulatory affairs is not limited to product approval. It extends to lifecycle
management, including post-marketing surveillance, renewals, and variations. Companies often rely on
regulatory intelligence to anticipate changes in global legislation and proactively adjust their
strategies. As global markets expand, pharmaceutical companies increasingly need to harmonize their
regulatory strategies across jurisdictions while addressing country-specific requirements. This need
gives rise to regulatory harmonization initiatives like ICH (International Council for
Harmonisation) and WHO’s collaborative registration procedures.

Ultimately, regulatory affairs ensure that patients have timely access to safe and effective
medications. It helps companies navigate a highly regulated environment, reduce compliance risks,
and bring innovations to market faster. As the regulatory landscape becomes more complex with the
advent of gene therapy, biosimilars, and personalized medicine, the demand for skilled regulatory
professionals continues to rise. For these reasons, pharma regulatory affairs are not just a support
function—they are a strategic pillar of the pharmaceutical business model.

## 2. Key Global Regulatory Authorities and Their Requirements

Pharmaceutical companies operating globally must adhere to regulatory frameworks set by each
country’s competent authority. These agencies oversee the entire lifecycle of pharmaceutical
products—from clinical trials to marketing authorization and post-market surveillance. The major
regulatory bodies include the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), European Medicines Agency
(EMA), Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) in India, the Pharmaceuticals and Medical
Devices Agency (PMDA) in Japan, and the Therapeutic Goods Administration (TGA) in Australia. Each
agency has its own application formats, timelines, electronic submission systems, and regulatory
expectations, making it crucial for regulatory teams to adopt a tailored approach for each region.

The U.S. FDA regulates drugs, biologics, and medical devices through a robust system that includes
pre-IND (Investigational New Drug) meetings, submission of IND applications for clinical trials, and
final approval via NDA (New Drug Application) or BLA (Biologics License Application). The FDA
mandates submission in electronic format via the Electronic Submissions Gateway (ESG) using the eCTD
standard. Additionally, periodic safety reporting, annual updates, and compliance with labeling and
promotional guidelines are essential post-approval obligations.

The EMA functions under the centralized procedure, where a single application leads to marketing
authorization across all EU member states. It also supports decentralized and mutual recognition
procedures (DCP and MRP) for drugs not eligible for centralized review. EMA requires rigorous
compliance with ICH guidelines and regional documentation in Module 1 of the eCTD. Scientific
advice, orphan designation, and accelerated assessment pathways are additional features companies
can leverage to expedite approvals.

### WHAT WE DO

# The Pharmaceutical Society of Nigeria

# Established with the following aims and objectives:

[ contact us ][48]
* To maintain ***a high standard of Professional ethics and discipline*** among its members
* To promote and maintain a ***high standard of Pharmaceutical Education*** in Nigeria
* To promote ***legislation*** for the enhancement of the image and the ***interest of the Pharmacy
  Profession*** and the Practitioners in Nigeria.
* To collate and disseminate statistical, scientific and other ***information relating to
  Pharmacy*** and publish such in an Official Journal
* To advice on Labour ***conditions relating to Pharmacists***.

#### Code of Ethics:

## The code of Ethics was designed by PCN

It’s a means of assisting Pharmacists to discharge their moral and Professional obligations resting
upon them to observe standards of conducts appropriate to their callings.

This code of Ethics applies to all registered Pharmacists holding Licences, Certificates or Permit
under the PCN Decree 91, of 1992 and Poison & Pharmacy Act Cap 535 1990.

Pharmacy is a regulated Profession beginning from training to registration in the different areas of
Practice.

### ** PWDAN**

#### ** The role we play**

The global development paradigm within the supply chain has made a tremendous impact that has
changed the face of pharmaceutical distribution with the attendant disruptions. In order to be
relevant in this era of uncertainty and disruptions, pharmaceutical wholesalers  and distributors
need to define its relevance in the rapidly changing supply chain landscape. The most perceived
strategy to overcome these challenges is by companies with common objective and interest to become
more resilient, collaborative and networked with other stake holders and players in the chain.
 Collectively they will be able to launch their entities/companies as vector of progress and
change.  This necessitated the coming together of this group.

### To protect

## To protect, project and harmonize the overall interest of PWDAN.

### To promote

## To promote good professional and inter-personal relationship among PWDAN members.

### To organize

## Organize workshops and seminars that promote global best practices in the pharmaceutical Supply
## chain

exporter of finished dosage forms (FDFs) and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). Our main goal
is to improve patient outcomes while establishing industry-defining standards. We strive to produce
necessary drugs that are affordable, easily available, and effective.

## best Services & Products

Pharmaceutical, a well-known pharmaceutical manufacturer and supplier in India. Customers can choose
from a variety of packaging solutions for their items, and flexible payment alternatives. They

### Vision & Mission
### 
### Mission et Vision

Our vision is to secure access to quality drugs. Our mission, with a pharmaceutical market that
represents more than $20 billion, bringing people quality products at affordable prices remains a
key challenge in Africa. CFAO Healthcare continues to improve healthcare on the continent by
producing and distributing pharmaceutical and medical products along with related services.

[ View more ][134]

### Carbon neutrality

Like the CFAO group as a whole, CFAO Healthcare is committed to contributing to decarbonization
efforts by aligning itself with the trajectory of the Paris agreements: reducing our greenhouse gas
emissions by 50% by 2030 compared with 2019 and achieving carbon neutrality by 2050.

[ View more ][135]

# Our History

1975 Opening of the first wholesale distributor company in the FOT
* Starting up of the activities of pre-wholesale In Algeria
* Starting up of the activities of Agent / distributor in Angola
Activity of Pre-Wholesale, Creation of E.P.DIS in Rouen (France)
Starting up of the activities of diagnostic & medical services Euracare (Nigeria and Ghana)
2 acquisitions
* Medimport (Mozambique)
* Opella South Africa which becomes CFAO Healthcare South Africa
3 acquisitions
* Missionpharma (Denmark / India)
* Assene-Laborex (Nigeria)
* Stockpharma (Portugal)
Acquisition of Maphar (Morocco) Sanofi contract with E.P.DIS France
Opening of the first wholesale distributor company in Dakar (Senegal), then development of the
wholesalers network in French-speaking sub-Saharan Africa until 1990
Acquisition of Fazzini (Italia)
Acquisition of 100% of Goodlife (Kenya / Uganda)
Ouverture du premier grossiste-répartiteur dans les CTOM
* Démarrage des activités de Pre-wholesale en Algérie.
* Démarrage des activités d'Agent/distributeur en Angola
Activité de Pre-wholesale, création d'E.P.DIS à Rouen (France)
Démarrage des activités des services diagnostiques & médicaux Euracare (Nigeria et Ghana)
2 acquisitions

## Frequently Asked Question

### 1. What does Farbe Firma specialize in manufacturing?

We are a specialized pharmaceutical formulation manufacturer focusing on Critical Care Injectables.
Our capabilities include liquid ampoules, sterile vials, Lyophilized (Freeze-Dried) injections, and
lipid emulsions across therapeutic areas like Anaesthesia, Pain Management, and Anti-infectives.


### 2. Are your manufacturing facilities WHO-GMP certified?

Yes, our manufacturing facility in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, is WHO-GMP certified. We adhere strictly to
global pharmacopeial standards (USP/BP/IP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) to ensure the
highest sterility and quality for international markets.


### 3. Do you offer Contract Manufacturing (CMO) and CDMO services?

Yes, we provide comprehensive Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.
We support global pharmaceutical companies with formulation development, private label
manufacturing, and scale-up of sterile injectables under their own brand names.


### 4. Which countries do you currently export to?

Farbe Firma exports to over 30 countries across Latin America, Africa, CIS, Southeast Asia, and the
Middle East. We have a dedicated export department that manages logistics and supply chain
compliance for global partners.


### 5. Do you provide Regulatory Dossiers and registration support?

Absolutely. We support our partners with complete regulatory documentation, including Dossiers
(CTD/ACTD formats), Certificates of Analysis (COA), and Stability Data to facilitate smooth product
registration in your local market.


### 6. How can I request a price quote or product sample?

For bulk inquiries, contract manufacturing proposals, or sample requests, please contact our export
team directly at [director@farbefirma.org][57] or via WhatsApp at +91 932 797 4224.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

M Care is an Indian-owned pharmaceutical export house supplying **WHO-GMP and EU-GMP** medicines,
biologicals and surgical consumables to hospitals, importers and government tender desks across

## Our supply-integrity promise.

For a buyer who has never met us, the real question is not the price. It is whether the box is what
the label says. This is the chain we hold on every single line we ship.

### Manufacturer-direct

Every line is sourced straight from a WHO-GMP manufacturer against your purchase order. We are not a
broker, we hold no speculative stock, and we do not buy on the grey market.

### Documented end to end

A batch Certificate of Analysis, the WHO-format CoPP, the manufacturer's GMP certificate and the
cold-chain trail travel with the consignment, prepared to your destination regulator's expectation.

### To your licensed entity

We supply the WHO-GMP product; the importer of record is your own licensed local entity. One named
desk carries the order from purchase order to the signature on the delivery note.

①

### Rooted in the world's pharmacy

India supplies ~60% of the world's vaccines and the largest share of quality-assured generics
outside the US. That is the manufacturing base we buy against, then QA, dossier and ship on your
behalf.

②

### Regulator-ready, destination-first

CTD/eCTD dossiers written for MHRA, EMA, SFDA, MoH-UAE, NAFDAC and the rest of the regulators we
ship into, not a generic template repurposed page-by-page.

③

### One named person on every order

No call-centre triage, no vanishing reply chains. Your Mumbai desk knows your molecule, your market,
your pack-size preference and your customs broker by name.

*From innovative brands to nationwide delivery
a 21‑year story of reliability, scale, and care driven by
Technology, Integrity, Professionalism and Service (TIPS)*

## Excellent Client Service Delivery

We provide excellent customer care, advisory services and
support tailored to the needs of Healthcare providers.
We have created a customer-centric system with our staff
equipped with the requisite tools to deliver efficiency and
best-in-class services.

## NHP Online
## Ordering Pad

## For New Heights Pharma Wholesales Ltd

With our Online Ordering Pad, registered pharmacies and
hospitals are able to place their orders and monitor their
transactions online real-time.

[ GET STARTED ][30]

## A one stop Healthcare Product
## Wholesale Centre

New Heights Pharma delivers quality healthcare products from its over 3000sqm wholesale and
distribution centre located in the centre of Lagos to over 4000 Healthcare providers in Nigeria and
across Africa.

## Nationwide Distribution Network

New Heights Pharma has one of the most extensive distribution network in Nigeria. Headquartered from
Lagos, We are able to supply quality healthcare products and services to over 4000 healthcare
providers and institutions in Nigeria, using our own logistics team trained on the importance of
Good Distribution Practice as well as other accredited logistics companies.

## not an healthcare professional

#### We've Got you Covered

[ Click here ][31]

#### Our Services

##### Wholesale

We as wholesalers act as middlemen for retail Pharmacies, Hospitals and other Health institutions.

[ Learn More ][32]

##### Distribution

We represent and distribute/Market products for International and Local brand that we are in
partnership with using dedicated field force personnel

[ Learn More ][33]

##### Marketing

We provide information by advertising and promoting our brands and product to the public.as well as
market and detail our products and services to healthcare professionals.

##### Consulting

We leverage our in-depth and cutting edge knowledge of the regulatory and compliance landscape to
provide a range of pharmaceutical consulting.

###### Our Culture

#### Excellent Service Delivery

We provide excellent services and support tailored to the needs of our customers. We have created a
customer focused environment where our staff are equipped with the tools to deliver quality products
and best-in-class services.

Receiving front door delivery service for your order is only a matter of getting in touch with our
customer care team.

We provide nationwide delivery services for orders received by Email, Text messages & Telephone
calls:
* 24 hours door step delivery within Lagos
* 72 hours nationwide door step delivery

At New Heights Pharma we strive to provide an efficient and fast turnaround on all orders placed.
Our customer relations officers are available between:
* 8am – 5pm Mondays to Fridays
* 9am – 3pm on Saturdays and Public holidays

###### Our Product

#### Leveraging Technology in Distribution and Sales

We have over the years developed requisite technological capabilities to automate our processes and
make transactions with our customers easy and seamless. With our Online Ordering Pad, registered
retail pharmacies and hospitals/clinics are able to make transactions and monitor their transactions
online real-time. With our app, customers are able to achieve the following:
* Automatically generate purchase orders for delivery
* Monitor orders online from the point of order to delivery
* Order to Cash Management and Automation
* Store transaction history with our company
* Get online notification on every order process
* Use one account to place orders for multiple locations and more

with a distinctive Research and Development Orientation that encompasses a wide variety of

pharmaceutical manufacturers.

Value Chain. The pharmaceutical market in Nigeria is estimated to reach US\$1,839 million in 2025

NIROPHARM is responsible for a large percentage of Pharmaceuticals imported into, and in circulation
in Nigeria and active in the News Media over issues relevant to the industry. Imports of

accounts for the remaining 30%.

# Mastering Global Regulatory Affairs in the Pharmaceutical Industry

## 1. Understanding the Role of Pharma Regulatory Affairs

Pharmaceutical Regulatory Affairs is a multidisciplinary function within the pharmaceutical and
biotechnology industries. It plays a critical role in ensuring that all products—drugs, biologics,
and medical devices—comply with the regulations and standards required by regulatory agencies across
various countries. The regulatory affairs department acts as the interface between pharmaceutical
companies and regulatory bodies such as the FDA (United States), EMA (European Union), CDSCO
(India), PMDA (Japan), and TGA (Australia). These agencies are responsible for reviewing and
approving drug applications, overseeing safety reporting, and enforcing post-approval compliance.

At its core, regulatory affairs involves the preparation, compilation, and submission of a wide
range of regulatory documents. These documents include dossiers (CTD/eCTD), product labels, periodic
safety reports, clinical trial applications, and responses to regulatory queries. In addition, the
regulatory team ensures that the company’s products are registered correctly in each market,
labeling is compliant, and pharmacovigilance systems are in place. Regulatory professionals must
stay up to date with evolving legislation and guidance documents, as non-compliance can result in
delayed product approvals, fines, or even market bans.

The scope of regulatory affairs is not limited to product approval. It extends to lifecycle
management, including post-marketing surveillance, renewals, and variations. Companies often rely on
regulatory intelligence to anticipate changes in global legislation and proactively adjust their
strategies. As global markets expand, pharmaceutical companies increasingly need to harmonize their
regulatory strategies across jurisdictions while addressing country-specific requirements. This need
gives rise to regulatory harmonization initiatives like ICH (International Council for
Harmonisation) and WHO’s collaborative registration procedures.

and bring innovations to market faster. As the regulatory landscape becomes more complex with the

# Mastering Global Regulatory Affairs in the Pharmaceutical Industry

## 1. Understanding the Role of Pharma Regulatory Affairs

Pharmaceutical Regulatory Affairs is a multidisciplinary function within the pharmaceutical and
biotechnology industries. It plays a critical role in ensuring that all products—drugs, biologics,
and medical devices—comply with the regulations and standards required by regulatory agencies across
various countries. The regulatory affairs department acts as the interface between pharmaceutical
companies and regulatory bodies such as the FDA (United States), EMA (European Union), CDSCO
(India), PMDA (Japan), and TGA (Australia). These agencies are responsible for reviewing and
approving drug applications, overseeing safety reporting, and enforcing post-approval compliance.

At its core, regulatory affairs involves the preparation, compilation, and submission of a wide
range of regulatory documents. These documents include dossiers (CTD/eCTD), product labels, periodic
safety reports, clinical trial applications, and responses to regulatory queries. In addition, the
regulatory team ensures that the company’s products are registered correctly in each market,
labeling is compliant, and pharmacovigilance systems are in place. Regulatory professionals must
stay up to date with evolving legislation and guidance documents, as non-compliance can result in
delayed product approvals, fines, or even market bans.

The scope of regulatory affairs is not limited to product approval. It extends to lifecycle
management, including post-marketing surveillance, renewals, and variations. Companies often rely on
regulatory intelligence to anticipate changes in global legislation and proactively adjust their
strategies. As global markets expand, pharmaceutical companies increasingly need to harmonize their
regulatory strategies across jurisdictions while addressing country-specific requirements. This need
gives rise to regulatory harmonization initiatives like ICH (International Council for
Harmonisation) and WHO’s collaborative registration procedures.

Ultimately, regulatory affairs ensure that patients have timely access to safe and effective
medications. It helps companies navigate a highly regulated environment, reduce compliance risks,
and bring innovations to market faster. As the regulatory landscape becomes more complex with the
advent of gene therapy, biosimilars, and personalized medicine, the demand for skilled regulatory
professionals continues to rise. For these reasons, pharma regulatory affairs are not just a support
function—they are a strategic pillar of the pharmaceutical business model.

## 2. Key Global Regulatory Authorities and Their Requirements

Pharmaceutical companies operating globally must adhere to regulatory frameworks set by each
country’s competent authority. These agencies oversee the entire lifecycle of pharmaceutical
products—from clinical trials to marketing authorization and post-market surveillance. The major
regulatory bodies include the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), European Medicines Agency
(EMA), Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) in India, the Pharmaceuticals and Medical
Devices Agency (PMDA) in Japan, and the Therapeutic Goods Administration (TGA) in Australia. Each
agency has its own application formats, timelines, electronic submission systems, and regulatory
expectations, making it crucial for regulatory teams to adopt a tailored approach for each region.

The U.S. FDA regulates drugs, biologics, and medical devices through a robust system that includes
pre-IND (Investigational New Drug) meetings, submission of IND applications for clinical trials, and
final approval via NDA (New Drug Application) or BLA (Biologics License Application). The FDA
mandates submission in electronic format via the Electronic Submissions Gateway (ESG) using the eCTD
standard. Additionally, periodic safety reporting, annual updates, and compliance with labeling and
promotional guidelines are essential post-approval obligations.

The EMA functions under the centralized procedure, where a single application leads to marketing
authorization across all EU member states. It also supports decentralized and mutual recognition
procedures (DCP and MRP) for drugs not eligible for centralized review. EMA requires rigorous
compliance with ICH guidelines and regional documentation in Module 1 of the eCTD. Scientific
advice, orphan designation, and accelerated assessment pathways are additional features companies
can leverage to expedite approvals.

under the PCN Decree 91, of 1992 and Poison & Pharmacy Act Cap 535 1990.

changed the face of pharmaceutical distribution with the attendant disruptions. In order to be
relevant in this era of uncertainty and disruptions, pharmaceutical wholesalers  and distributors
need to define its relevance in the rapidly changing supply chain landscape. The most perceived
strategy to overcome these challenges is by companies with common objective and interest to become
more resilient, collaborative and networked with other stake holders and players in the chain.
 Collectively they will be able to launch their entities/companies as vector of progress and
change.  This necessitated the coming together of this group.

## To protect, project and harmonize the overall interest of PWDAN.

Salvavidas Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is committed to being the world’s leading manufacturer and
exporter of finished dosage forms (FDFs) and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). Our main goal
is to improve patient outcomes while establishing industry-defining standards. We strive to produce
necessary drugs that are affordable, easily available, and effective.

## We are offering
## best Services & Products

High-quality pharmaceutical, ayurvedic, and antibiotic medications are available from Salvavidas
Pharmaceutical, a well-known pharmaceutical manufacturer and supplier in India. Customers can choose
from a variety of packaging solutions for their items, and flexible payment alternatives. They
guarantee on-time delivery and keep their prices competitive. Salvavidas Pharmaceutical puts the
needs of its patients first by improving safety, efficacy, convenience, and compliance while
offering reasonably priced goods that benefit both patients and society as a whole.

medicines on schedule and at fair prices. We promise that every product meets the highest caliber
throughout its development, manufacturing, sale, distribution, etc. We are dedicated to establishing

developed to fulfill the requirements of its customers, such as antimalarials, analgesics, and

in India.

laboratories with innovative diagnostic technologies and reagents that support accurate detection,
monitoring, and management of disease.

radiology solutions provide reliable technologies that help clinicians capture detailed images,
detect conditions early, and guide the right treatment decisions.

[DISCOVER][42]

Millions of people around the world suffer from chronic wounds, often facing months of pain, reduced
quality of life, and ongoing care needs. With our advanced wound care products and sutures, we are
committed to helping patients achieve the effective, precise solutions they need for optimal healing
and better outcomes.

[DISCOVER][43]

When every heartbeat matters, every monitor counts. Uni-medical’s critical care systems give
clinicians the tools to act fast, stay precise, and save lives, because in the ICU, seconds make the
difference.

[DISCOVER][44]

Modern care demands precision. Uni-medical’s endoscopy technologies help clinicians visualize,
diagnose, and treat conditions with the precision required for minimally invasive medicine.

## FAQ’s

If you have any questions about our brands, products or company we have a team on hand to support
you throughout the working week.

Get in touch with us for anything you might need.

##### What products does Uni-medical supply?

Uni-medical provides a wide range of healthcare solutions including diagnostic equipment, radiology
systems, critical care devices, endoscopy technologies, medical consumables, and laboratory
solutions.

##### What category of medical comsumables do you supply?

Uni-medical supplies essential consumables such as gloves, PPE, wound care products, infection
control products and other clinical supplies used daily in healthcare settings.

### Can’t find an answer to your question?

We have more answers to your frequently asked questions

[GET AN ANSWER][51]

##### Do you provide delivery for medical equipment supplies?

Yes. We manage the logistics and delivery of medical equipment and supplies to healthcare
facilities. Our team works to ensure products are delivered safely and efficiently to support timely
installation and use.

##### Can we request a product demonstration?

Yes. Healthcare facilities can request a product demonstration to better understand how specific
equipment works and how it can support their clinical needs. Simply submit a request through our
contact or sales inquiry form, and our team will coordinate the next steps.

##### Do you provide installation for medical equipment?

Yes. Our engineering team provides professional installation to ensure all equipment is set up
correctly and performs to the highest standards.

##### Do you provide after-sales support for equipment?

Yes. We offer installation, preventive maintenance, calibration, and technical support through our
experienced engineering team to ensure equipment continues to perform reliably.

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.
